Jermaine Gordon is a licensed massage therapist and certified strength and conditioning specialist. He specializes in sports massage and neuromuscular therapy. Jermaine has been teaching massage therapy for 15 years and is currently an adjunct professor in a massage therapy program where he currently practices in Miami, Florida. With 20 plus years of performing soft tissue work, he is passionate about sharing his knowledge working with athletes on how to treat their body for better performance. 

DISCLAIMER: THE VIDEOS POSTED ON THIS PAGE IS FOR EDUCATIONAL PURPOSES ONLY. ANY OF THE TECHNIQUES DEMONSTRATED ARE NOT TO BE USED OR ATTEMPTED BY ANYONE OTHER THAN A LICENSED MASSAGE THERAPIST. 

DO NOT USE THE VIDEOS ON THIS PAGE TO DIAGNOSE ANY MEDICAL CONDITION. PLEASE CONSULT YOUR MEDICAL PHYSICIAN IF YOU HAVE ANY PAIN OR DISCOMFORT.
